title: Count lone pairs in a multiple bond
hints: Finish the octet on a terminal O.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Each double bond contributes four shared electrons to that oxygen’s octet. The remaining four are two lone pairs.
statement:
How many lone pairs are on each oxygen in the common Lewis structure of $\ce{CO2}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: Four shared plus four nonbonding electrons give an octet.
This gives only six electrons around O.
With the double bond this gives ten, invalid for O.
This leaves only the shared electrons.
